title: Obstructed Lattice

story.briefing: The conduit grid again, but sections of it have collapsed. Count the routes that still get through, right and down only.
story.success: Surviving routes counted. The controller reroutes around the collapse.

description: Given a grid of 0 (open) and 1 (blocked), count the routes from the top-left cell to the bottom-right cell, moving only right or down and passing through open cells only. Return 0 if either corner is blocked or no route exists.
hints: This is the open-grid route count with one extra rule: a blocked cell has no routes through it at all, whatever its neighbours say.
Set a blocked cell to zero rather than skipping it, so the cells after it inherit the zero naturally. The first row and column need the same treatment — one block cuts everything beyond it.
Fill a table in reading order. A blocked cell gets 0. The start cell gets 1 if open. Every other open cell is the sum of the cells above and to its left, treating anything off the grid as 0.
